name: The Gamers Lounge
description: Malta's most popular PC gaming center. High-end PC gaming stations and peripherals.
notes: Good place to play PC games or meet other gamers during your downtime.

name: Eden Esports Centre (Eden SuperBowl)
address: Eden SuperBowl, St. George's Bay, St. Julian's
description: Esports area and PC setups located inside the Eden SuperBowl complex.
notes: Convenient if you also want to bowl or grab drinks in the busy St. Julian's area.

name: Mdina (The Silent City)
description: Historic fortified city and former capital of Malta. Famous for its medieval architecture and narrow streets.
notes: Very close to Attard (where the BLAST Arena is). Highly recommended for a half-day trip before the matches.

name: Valletta
description: Current capital of Malta, UNESCO World Heritage site known for museums, palaces, and grand churches.
notes: Easily accessible by bus from Qawra or a 30-min ride share.
